signatures.description: Implement a non-interactive distributed key generation resharing protocol (Pedersen/GJKR style) in Go: new-committee members verify pairwise Feldman commitments against transcript hashes, file complaints, and adjudicate them from broadcast evidence, producing the combined group public key and a proof that secret sharing stayed intact across the epoch. Graded on a scenario suite with byzantine dealers posting inconsistent shares, delinquent receivers, and a mid-reshare membership overlap of only t nodes. Output must be verifiable with pairings and must not leak the reconstructed secret even in complaint evidence.
